items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: We worked together, we made a recording... we sing together with Caney, Cuarteto Caney.

ctx.x: At La Conga. When he came to Havana Madrid he played about two or three years or four and then from there we went to La Conga. We worked together, we made a recording, as a matter of fact, he was the first one to give me the break, to sing on recording, so we sing together with Caney, Cuarteto Caney.
